title: EEG Pre/Post Intervention Dataset
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings collected from participants across multiple groups, assessed at pre- and post-intervention timepoints. It was designed to investigate changes in neural activity associated with an intervention, organized following the BIDS specification for interoperability. The dataset supports analyses such as EEG signal processing, functional connectivity, and pre/post comparisons.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using standard acquisition systems. Recordings are organized by participant and session (pre/post intervention), with detailed acquisition parameters provided in JSON sidecar files accompanying each EEG recording.
